title: Allows floating cards to have a slight projection
goal: Use box-shadow to set offset, blur, and color with transparency.
summary: Equipment status card floats on the light page. Hierarchy is represented by soft shadows pointing downwards.
tasks: Add a shadow to .raised with a horizontal offset of 0, a vertical offset of 4px, a blur of 10px, and a diffusion of 0.
uses rgba(25, 65, 57, .25) as the shadow color, and the card text color remains unchanged.

example.note: The first two lengths are the horizontal and vertical offset, and the third length is the blur radius.

hint: box-shadow draws the shadow of the entire card. Text shadow is another property.
